content.text: The project, valued at €160,242, exhibits significant compliance risks due to incomplete performance descriptions. Critical medium-severity defects affect €6,884 in items, primarily missing mandatory specifications for floor insulation (GEG compliance), soil excavation (DIN 18300), and waterproofing (DIN 18533). These omissions violate VOB/A and VOB/C requirements, creating legal and technical uncertainties. Additional low-severity ambiguities in paving, asphalt, and masonry specifications further complicate accurate estimating and execution. Immediate revision of the tender documents is required to define material standards, dimensions, and norms. This will mitigate cost overrun risks, ensure regulatory compliance, and enable precise contractor bidding, safeguarding the project’s technical integrity and financial control.
